official_layers.name: Max for Live Live API / LOM

ableton_live.continuous_external_control: best through LOM/OSC/Remote Script bridge; Extensions are discrete actions
ableton_live.recommended_agent_workflow: Session View divergent clips/scenes -> Arrangement View final chronology -> render/analyze
ableton_live.expression_and_tuning: discover per connection; see the adapter file

fl_studio.critical_modeling_note: Playlist lanes are not Mixer tracks by default
fl_studio.recommended_agent_workflow: Instrument Track/Track Mode -> Patterns/Piano Roll -> Playlist -> Automation Clips -> Mixer -> render/analyze
fl_studio.expression_and_tuning: discover per connection; see the adapter file

pro_tools.note_level_generation: use MIDI Builder/import, Sketch, or MIDI effects; do not assume public PTSL note API
pro_tools.deployment_constraint: PTSL SDK use is local-computer only under Avid license; certificate required for licensed products
pro_tools.recommended_agent_workflow: Sketch/external MIDI -> Edit timeline -> routing/folders/playlists -> commit/freeze -> bounce/analyze
pro_tools.expression_and_tuning: discover per connection; see the adapter file

expression_and_tuning_note: Per-note expression, MPE routing and tuning import are connection capabilities, not product facts, so they are discovered per setup rather than listed here. shared/DAW_ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md section 10 says what to ask; each adapter file lists what to check first for that DAW. An adapter fills daw_capabilities at run time; a value in this file would be a claim about someone else's machine.
